article.story: NEW YORK -- — Gerard O'Keefe scored 24 points as Columbia beat Albany 93-65 on Saturday. O'Keefe shot 9 for 12, including 6 for 9 from beyond the arc for the Lions (9-1). Kenny Noland added 16 points, five rebounds and five assists. Connor Igoe had 13 points and shot 4 of 4 from the field and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line. The Lions extended their winning streak to eight games. Jaden Kempson finished with 13 points for the Great Danes (2-7). Nasir Muhammad added 12 points for Albany. Ife West-Ingram also had 11 points and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
